issue_context.title: [Feature] Allow to define an interval / wait period between expect.poll assertions
issue_context.body:
In one of the latest versions of Playwright the `expect.poll`-function was introduced to allow to poll for a specific assertion. This is really a great addition to Playwright. 

Only I would like to request an enhancement to this functionality to delay a breathing period between assertion checks. For example, when you are querying for a status change via an API endpoint then it can be beneficial to wait a short period between assertion checks to not hit the API server too often or it might not beneficial to continuously execute this assertion.

In my case I would like to check if a revocation of permissions has completed, and it doesn't make sense to check the assertion of a period of 60 seconds continuously. A bit of breathing or waiting time of like 5 seconds would help to ease everything
